summary: Frontend-only test of the 'Scarmenta vs Others' demo game rework (two wallets, 3-of-5 heavy-side-loses pattern, Repeat/Double, refill dialog, persistence) plus regression checks on Andar Bahar and Teen Patti. Logged in as demo@aetheria.io and ran 3 Playwright runs on desktop 1920x1080, with one mobile 390x844 screenshot. Every requested feature works as specified, and no bugs that block use were found.
verified: Tab demo-tab-rivals is labelled 'Scarmenta vs Others'. With a fresh state the wallets show '5,000 cr' and '₹5,000'. demo-balance is hidden on rivals and shown on AB/TP tabs. There is no tie spot.
Chips show 50/100/500/1K with no $ prefix. Badges show '1,000 cr' and '₹500'.
10 rounds of S1000+O500 from a fresh state gave the sequence O,O,S,S,O | S,O,S,O,O. Scarmenta (the bigger bet) lost exactly 3 rounds in each block of 5.

Math with multiplier 5 (from /api/public/config): when Others wins it shows 'Others +₹500 profit', '− ₹200 paid for 1,000 cr (1/5)', 'Net profit ₹300'. When Scarmenta wins it shows 'Scarmenta +1,000 cr', 'Others −₹500', 'Net loss ₹300', with no cost line. Wallet deltas were correct in every round.
A single-side bet (Others ₹100 only) shows only the Others line, with no net or cost line, and the wallet changes correctly.

Repeat re-places the last bets (used for rounds 2-10). Double turns current 500cr/₹100 into 1,000cr/₹200, and with no bets placed it doubles the last bet (₹100 to ₹200). Both buttons are disabled at first. Clear works.

A bet that does not fit opens rivals-refill-dialog: on the 4th 1K click with a 3,000 cr wallet, and on the 6th 1K click on Others with ₹5,000. Share & refill opens api.whatsapp.com with the referral code and link, closes the dialog and sets both wallets to 5,000. Deposit goes to /app/deposits.
Wallets loaded from localStorage after reload (3,000 cr / ₹6,000).
Regression: Andar Bahar ($ chips, $1,000 balance, +$90 win) and Teen Patti (+$50) play normally. Reset sets the $ balance back to $1,000 and leaves the rivals wallets alone.

issues: The title always says 'Demo wallet is empty', even when the wallet is not empty and the bet just doesn't fit (e.g. 3,000 cr left). Suggested title: 'Not enough demo balance'.
After Share & refill, the bet that triggered the dialog is not placed; the user has to click again. Minor UX point.
The result lines are text-xs in a w-44 column between the cards and are hard to read on desktop. They may get cramped on mobile (390px) when all 4 lines show.
Profit/Loss and Biggest win stay at $0.00 for rivals rounds (separate:true), while Rounds/Wins/Losses count them. This looks intended but may confuse users.

action_items: Optional: change the refill dialog title so it fits the 'bet exceeds wallet' case
Optional: after a refill, automatically place the bet that triggered the dialog
Optional: make the rivals result text larger
critical_code_review_comments: Share & refill refills the wallets as soon as window.open is called, whether or not the user actually shares. This is acceptable for a demo but cannot be verified.
If both bets are equal, pickWinner picks the heavy side at random but still uses a schedule slot. This is fine and matches the spec.
seed_data_creation: None. Only browser localStorage in the test contexts was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The demo page is at /app/demo-game. Rivals state is in localStorage key scarmenta_demo_rivals {schedule:[bool x5], wallets}; true = the bigger side loses. The login submit testid is login-submit-button. AB/TP use BetSpot ids andar/bahar and tp-scarmenta/tp-rivals, with deal buttons demo-ab-deal-button and demo-tp-deal-button.
